notes: Recorded 7 named fields per level (bachelor 7, master 7, doctorate 7); the page names no individual programmes and ends the list with 'etc.', so this is the full list the official pages give, not a programme catalogue.

The Sri Lanka scheme's HEC subject list (separate scheme pages under the Sri Lanka programme) was checked: neither this scheme's pages nor the flyer link to it or say it applies, so it was NOT reused here.

Conflict between pages: the scheme page and overview list undergraduate, master's and PhD levels, but the flyer for the earlier call (deadline 15 December 2025) says only 'Bachelor of Science (4-5 years)' with 'Fields: Non-Engineering, Medical & Allied Health Sciences', which does not match the field list on the scheme page. Editors should treat the field list as the scheme page's own wording.
any_subject not set: the fields are named, the page does not say others are excluded or open.
